svg.text: A stem runs from each tile through the shell
and ends in a soft pad near the skin.
Pad stops 0.5 off the skin at rest, so a pushed tile
Number = gap from shell to skin, mm
Tiles with no contact are left out because
the face is over 18 away or an opening is too close.
